Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document 
 outlines the equipment inspection I2, which 
 must performed on an annually basis as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first 
 draft initiated by eng: Gad El Mawla Mohamed Abd El Rahman, tested by eng 
 Mohamed Atta Farag and eng. Khaled Mohamed Abdel Fatah, revised by EDEPC quality control eng Abd EL Monaem AL Emam, 
 accepted by general director eng Tarek Youssef and approved by 
 eng. Mekhaael George Habashi Sector 
 inspector of Ayoun Moussa power station.
This document 
 accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil EDEPC MPIS Coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC 
 admin. & financial inspection & quality control's general director and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector
Safety 
Precautions
A work order must be issued, the maintenance staff should be 
 qualified and carry the suitable safety ID category.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as 
 safety helmet, 
 safety shoes, anti static hand probe to avoid electrical shock, nose mouth dust 
 cover, ... etc
Take care 
 that the
 unit in service.

and Equipment
Digital multi-meter.
Screw driver kit.
Hand held Radio wave for 
 communication.
Antistatic vacuum 
 cleaner for dust cleaning

be Carried Out
